source_bundle.mjcf_upstream: Gymnasium Robotics v1.4.2 (commit 42eae53b2b27321d29090c219ce2f675c596de77) Shadow Hand, flattened by the bundle to Isaac Lab's repose-cube configuration (Profile B: four J1/J0 coupling tendons)

licenses.LICENSE.md: the bundle's model_parity_audit/.../envs/assets/LICENSE.md, verbatim: the Shadow Hand model's attribution and its Apache License 2.0 terms; the bundle's THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md says it must stay with the STL assets. It is also the licence textures/block.png ships under (the same gymnasium-robotics envs/assets tree)

meshes.pre_scaling: The source's <mesh scale="0.001 0.001 0.001">, which crates/es-assets/src/mjcf/elements.rs refuses by name, baked into the vertex data: binary STL, 80-byte header and triangle count kept, each 50-byte facet's nine vertex floats replaced by float32(float64(v) * 0.001) (one rounding), the facet normal kept (a uniform scale does not change it), the attribute count written as 0. Sizes are unchanged.

derivation: Kept unchanged: every body, inertial, joint (name, axis, range, damping; armature except the class default below), geom (type, size, pose, friction, condim, contype, conaffinity, mass), the <option> (timestep 1/120 s, implicitfast, 20 iterations), the four coupling tendons' joints, coefficients, limits and damping, the 17 <contact><pair>s, every body's gravcomp, the 24 jointpos sensors and the <default> classes' dynamics attributes.
Header comment and model name replaced (`shadow_hand_repose`); XML comments added where something was added.
<compiler>: meshdir is `meshes/` (the vendored copies), texturedir `textures/` (the vendored block.png, packet H1b; H1 had dropped it)

Dropped as not represented by SceneDesc and not dynamics: <size> (njmax, nconmax, nstack, nuser_*: memory sizing and user-data widths), <custom> (the bundle's metadata texts and the joint velocity limit 100.00003814697266 rad/s, which the source's own comment says has no native MJCF meaning), <visual>, <light name="light0">, every `user` attribute (joints and actuators), `group` on sites and geoms, the <default> class `robot0:asset_class`'s joint `margin="0"` (MuJoCo's default) and site `rgba`, `content_type` on meshes.
Dropped with their only users: the five <touch> sensors, the five `robot0:Tch_*` sites they read and the `robot0:D_Touch` default class.

<asset> (packet H1b; H1 had dropped every texture and material and moved their colours to rgba): kept, attribute for attribute, the texture `texture:object` (block.png, cube, linear, gridsize 3 4, gridlayout .U..LFRB.D..) and the materials robot0:MatColl, robot0:MatViz, material:object and material:target, each less `reflectance="0.5"` (es-assets does not read it and es-render draws no reflection; left in, it is an unknown-attribute warning). Dropped as unused here: the skybox, robot0:texplane, robot0:texgeom and texture:hidden (block_hidden.png, `object_hidden`'s), and the materials robot0:MatGnd, robot0:object, floor_mat and material:hidden. Class `robot0:D_Vizual` names MatViz again and has no rgba of its own, so the visual meshes wear MatViz's 0.93 grey (specular 0.75, shininess 0.1: a PBR material in es-render, roughness from renderer.md 15.1's formula). Class `robot0:DC_Hand` names MatColl and keeps rgba "0.4 0.5 0.6 0": a geom rgba other than MuJoCo's default wins over its material's (setMaterial, renderer.md 15.1), so the resolved alpha is 0 and the collision geoms draw nothing (crates/es-render/tests/shadow_hand.rs). The seven collision geoms' own translucent rgba overrides (0.1 / 0.2 / 0.7, which only served MuJoCo's viewer) stay removed. The floor `floor0` keeps floor_mat's colour "0.2 0.2 0.2 0" as its own rgba: alpha 0, as in the source. Alpha 0 is not drawn by es-render (crates/es-render/src/scene.rs, packet H1).
<mesh scale="0.001 0.001 0.001"> removed from the ten meshes whose STLs are pre-scaled (see `meshes`).

The twenty <general dyntype=none gaintype=fixed gainprm="kp" biastype="affine" biasprm="0 -kp -kv"> servos written as <position kp="kp" kv="kv">, which MuJoCo compiles to exactly those parameters (wrist: kp 5, kv 0.5; the rest: kp 1, kv 0.10000000149011612); ctrlrange, forcerange and class kept, and the class's <general ctrllimited forcelimited> default written as <position ...>.
The four tendons' `springlength="0"` dropped: MuJoCo's default is the length at qpos0, which is 0 for these couplings (every joint at 0), and their stiffness is 0.
Single-value site sizes (`object:center`, `target:center`, size 0.01) written as three values, which is what MuJoCo expands them to; their rgba (alpha 0) dropped.

Four orientations written as the unit vectors SceneDesc stores, so that `parse -> SceneDesc -> scene_to_mjcf` writes them back bit for bit and MuJoCo compiles the emitted file exactly as it compiles this one: the hand mount's quat (9.381843730734243e-7 9.381873730746175e-7 -0.7071082811849306 0.7071052811837377, source 9.38184e-07 9.38187e-07 -0.707108 0.707105), LFJ4's axis (0.5709770263548727 0 0.8209660378937408, source 0.570977 0 0.820966), thbase's quat (0.9239559191829653 0 0.3824989665433906 0, source 0.923956 0 0.382499 0) and C_wrist's quat (0.7071067811865476 0.7071067811865476 0 0, source 0.707107 0.707107 0 0). The first two are exactly what MuJoCo makes of the source text; for the last two, es_math::Quat::normalize and MuJoCo's normalization differ in the last bit and no value is a fixed point of both.

The held cube `object`: its box keeps collision, mass 0.216, condim 4 and friction, and wears material:object (block.png) as in the source (packet H1b; H1 had given it alpha 0 and six coloured visual-only face slabs, now removed); `object_hidden` (the textured inner cube, mass 0, no collision) dropped. MuJoCo's compiled mass and inertia of the body are the source's (0.216 kg, diag 1.296e-4), with or without H1's slabs.

The goal cube `target`: moved from (1, 0.87, 0.2) -- where it overlapped the held cube -- to (1.12, 0.87, 0.2), beside the little finger, where all three cameras see it (the Task IR's reset sets its pose); its box wears material:target (block.png, rgba "1 1 1 0.5") as in the source (packet H1b; H1's six slabs removed). es-render renders no transparency: the 0.5 alpha draws OPAQUE (only alpha 0 is special). gravcomp 1, no collision, mass 0.216 as in the source.
Added `ceiling_light`: a visual-only world box (half extents 0.6 0.6 0.005 at (1, 0.95, 0.9), rgba 1) whose `_light` suffix makes it the path tracer's emitter.

Added three world-fixed cameras at fovy 45 (MJCF: look down -Z, +Y up): `top` at (1.04, 0.88, 0.56) looking straight down, image up +Y (towards the wrist); `front` at (1.04, 0.52, 0.36) aimed at (1.04, 0.87, 0.17), in front of the fingertips (xyaxes "1 0 0 0 0.4771 0.8789"); `side` at (0.68, 0.72, 0.36) aimed at (1.04, 0.88, 0.17), from the thumb side and in front (xyaxes "0.4061 -0.9138 0 0.397 0.1764 0.9007"). Chosen by rendering them (crates/es-render/tests/shadow_hand.rs, ES_RENDER_DUMP).

Dynamics edit (packet H2b, docs/packets/M16/plan-h.md): class `robot0:asset_class`'s joint armature 0 -> 0.001, gymnasium-robotics' own value (gymnasium_robotics/envs/assets/hand/shared.xml, default class robot0:asset_class: armature="0.001"); the bundle's Phase 4A had set it to 0 for Isaac parity. It reaches the 22 finger and thumb joints; the two wrist joints keep their explicit 0.005. Why: with armature 0 the ~1e-5 kg m^2 finger links under the kp servos at dt 1/120 s drive qacc past mjMAXVAL whenever the servo targets jump (a policy's fresh target every 60 Hz tick), and MuJoCo then resets the data to qpos0 by itself -- cube and goal at the identity, which the repose task scores as a success. Nothing else changes.
measured: MuJoCo 3.13.0 compiles the source file and this one to the same model in everything that reaches the dynamics except: dof_armature on the 22 finger and thumb dofs (0.001, packet H2b, and what mj_setConst derives from it);thbase's body_quat and C_wrist's geom_quat (1 ulp, 1.1e-16), and what mj_setConst derives from them (dof_invweight0, body_invweight0, actuator_acc0, dof_M0: <= 2e-10 relative); the target's body_pos and qpos0 (moved); pair_geom1/2 (indices shift by one: ceiling_light is a world geom); dof_length (the slabs and pre-scaled meshes change body extents; no effect on the trajectory, below).

Measured before packet H2b's armature edit (the one dynamics difference since): with the source's four orientation strings and target position put back, this file and the source give bit-identical qpos (MuJoCo 3.13.0, 240 ticks from qpos0: 120 with every servo at 0 clamped to its range, then 120 at 10 / 20 / 30 / 40% of its range): the servo respelling, the removals, the slabs and the pre-scaled meshes change nothing. As committed, the one-ulp orientations grow through contact: after those 240 ticks the hand and held cube differ from the source by 1.7e-10 / 4.0e-10 / 2.9e-7 / 1.1e-5. With every servo held at 0, both files run 10 s without a MuJoCo instability warning.

crates/es-physics-backend/tests/shadow_hand.rs: MuJoCoCpuBackend (parse -> SceneDesc -> emitted MJCF) and MuJoCo loading this file directly agree bit for bit (max |dqpos| 0.0) over 240 ticks, 120 at the servos' zero and 120 at 40% of their ranges, up to 13 contacts including fingertip pairs (11 with armature 0.001, packet H2b).

Packet H2b, a fresh uniform servo target over each ctrlrange every 60 Hz tick for 15 s (crates/es-physics-backend/tests/shadow_hand.rs, --ignored): with armature 0, MuJoCo 3.13.0 auto-reset 338 env-steps over 4 envs (max |qvel| 7.6e7) and mujoco_warp 3.13.0 went past mjMAXVAL on 55,955 of 57,600 env-steps over 64 worlds (max |qvel| 1.5e15); with armature 0.001, 0 and 0 (max |qvel| 12.8 and 20.9 rad/s). A 1/240 s step also gave 0; contacts off, tendons unlimited, joint limits off or the implicit integrator did not (measured by H2).

crates/es-render/tests/shadow_hand.rs: at 96x96 the held cube covers 462 / 467 / 524 pixels and the goal cube 500 / 508 / 235 in top / front / side (CPU Rs; the Pt segmentation agrees) -- the same counts with H1's slabs and with packet H1b's textured boxes.

Packet H1b, physics unchanged (MuJoCo 3.13.0): the file before and after H1b compile to the same body_mass, body_inertia, body_ipos, body_iquat, dof_armature, dof_invweight0, body_invweight0, actuator_acc0, dof_M0, qpos0 and stat.meaninertia (object 0.216 kg, inertia diag 1.296e-4 in both), and their qpos over 240 ticks under H1's controls (120 at the servos' zero, 120 at 40% of their ranges) is bit-identical at every tick (only dof_length differs, as for H1's slabs, and ngeom 61 -> 49). crates/es-physics-backend/tests/shadow_hand.rs still gives max |dqpos| 0.0 against MuJoCo on the file (11 contacts), and H2b's stress 0 / 0 diverged env-steps (max |qvel| 12.8 / 20.9 rad/s on mujoco-cpu / mjwarp, the H2b numbers).

Packet H1b, placement (crates/es-render/tests/shadow_hand.rs mujoco_puts_the_block_texture_where_we_do, 192x192, CPU Rs Lambert against mujoco.Renderer at qpos0 with the headlight's specular at 0 and the goal's material alpha at 1 -- shading, not placement): every cube face of at least 200 pixels has the same dominant block.png backdrop in both images and >= 0.85 per-pixel agreement: top object +Z 0.999, target +Z 0.996; front object -Y 0.970, +Z 0.975, target -Y 0.969, +Z 0.977; side object -X 0.975, -Y 0.853, +Z 0.972, target -X 0.982. Packet H1b, the Task IR's cameras (Pt, 4 spp, 3 bounces, exposure 8, 96x96, the scene's static pose): no pixel at 255 in any channel (brightest 245 / 241 / 244 in top / front / side; Rs 247 / 246 / 246); both cubes are clearly visible in their backdrop colours in all three cameras; the top camera's letters (P) are readable, the front / side faces' letters are mostly lost in 4 spp noise at 96x96.
